action: Belo Horizonte taxpayers who issued a payment slip between 14 and the morning of 16 November should not pay it and should generate a new one; anyone who paid by Pix should check the payee and, if wrong, contact their bank and ask for MED.
date_note: Date of the city's confirmation; the affected issuing window began on 14 November.
exec: A city's tax-slip system was tampered with, so payments could go to the wrong party; payment-slip systems need integrity checks.
plain: Belo Horizonte's city hall says a cyberattack hit the system that issues tax payment slips. Slips issued from 14 to 16 November should not be paid and must be reissued.

key_findings: The city confirmed a cyberattack on its municipal tax payment-slip system, which it said was similar to attacks on other public bodies.
Slips issued between the early hours of 14 November and the morning of 16 November should not be paid; new slips can be generated via the Portal de Serviços or BH SIM app.
Due dates of affected slips were extended to 19 November; slips paid by barcode or automatic debit were not affected.
The city told financial institutions and police; it says the system was restored.

sources.name: Diário do Comércio: Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte confirma ataque cibernético e orienta reemissão de guias de tributos

summary: Belo Horizonte's city hall confirmed a cyberattack on the system that issues municipal tax payment slips. It told taxpayers not to pay slips issued from the early hours of 14 November to the morning of 16 November and to generate new ones. The city says the system was restored and extended due dates to 19 November.
title: Belo Horizonte city confirms cyberattack on tax payment-slip system

validation.note: Single news report relaying the city's statement; a figure of about 250 taxpayers in an Impactto News headline was not read and is not used.

review.note: Compared city confirmation, 14-16 Nov slip window, extension to 19 Nov, Pix/MED advice, restored status, no figures or actor against Diario do Comercio 16 Nov 2026
